scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f tests/integration/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f tests/integration/docker-compose.yml up -d && { vitest run -c vitest.integration.config.ts; code=$?; docker compose -f tests/integration/docker-compose.yml down -v; exit $code; }
scripts.package: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo "Working tree is not clean. source.zip is written from HEAD but dist/ is built from the working tree, so they would describe different code. Commit or stash first." >&2; exit 1; } && npm run build && npm run lint:ext && git archive --format=zip -o source.zip HEAD
scripts.sign:unlisted: npm test && npm run package && web-ext sign -s dist --channel=unlisted --upload-source-code=source.zip
